name: averqel-kinesis-desktop
description: Offline-first local AI and coding workspace

scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run prepare:frontend && pnpm run prepare:brand-assets && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.build:linux:x64: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run prepare:frontend && pnpm run prepare:brand-assets && electron-builder --publish never --linux deb rpm AppImage --x64
scripts.build:linux:arm64: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run prepare:frontend && pnpm run prepare:brand-assets && electron-builder --publish never --linux deb rpm AppImage --arm64
scripts.build:windows:x64: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run prepare:frontend && pnpm run prepare:brand-assets && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis --x64
scripts.build:windows:arm64: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run prepare:frontend && pnpm run prepare:brand-assets && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis --arm64
scripts.build:mac:x64: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run prepare:frontend && pnpm run prepare:brand-assets && electron-builder --publish never --mac dmg --x64
scripts.build:mac:arm64: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run prepare:frontend && pnpm run prepare:brand-assets && electron-builder --publish never --mac dmg --arm64

linux.synopsis: Offline-first local AI and coding workspace
linux.description: Run AverQel Kinesis with a bundled local API, local AI models, and user-selected coding projects.
